Name: Spacebox basics
Description: From your first flight to your first spaceship.

Steps.Title: Look around
Steps.Text: Welcome, astronaut! Move the mouse to look around.

Steps.Title: Learn to fly
Steps.Text: There is no gravity here. Fly with {key:forward} {key:left} {key:backward} {key:right}, go up with {key:up} and down with {key:down}.

Steps.Title: Roll in space
Steps.Text: In space there is no up or down. Roll with {key:rollLeft} and {key:rollRight}.

Steps.Title: Light the dark
Steps.Text: Asteroids are dark inside. Switch your flashlight with {key:flashlight}.

Steps.Title: All controls
Steps.Text: Forgot a key? Press {key:inputOverlay} at any time to see all controls.

Steps.Title: The hotbar
Steps.Text: The bar at the bottom holds your tools. Select a slot with the mouse wheel or the number keys.

Steps.Title: Inventory
Steps.Text: Open your inventory with {key:inventory}. Drag items between slots, Shift-click moves them quickly.

Steps.Title: Place a block
Steps.Text: Select the crafting table in the hotbar and place it with {key:block_place}.

Steps.Title: Rotate and magnet
Steps.Text: Hold a block: {key:block_rotate} rotates it. {key:magnet} toggles the magnet, so blocks snap to the surface you look at.

Steps.Title: Place the furnace
Steps.Text: Place the furnace next to the crafting table. This is the start of your base.

Steps.Title: Mine some rock
Steps.Text: Select the drill and hold {key:block_destroy} on an asteroid block. Drilling uses power, watch the power bar.
Steps.Hint: Mined blocks fly to you. Get close to pick them up.

Steps.Title: Find ores
Steps.Text: Ores are blocks with colored spots. Your drill is strong enough for aluminium and cobaltite.

Steps.Title: Ice is water
Steps.Text: Light blue ice blocks melt into water. You will need it for oxygen.

Steps.Title: Use the furnace
Steps.Text: Look at the furnace and press {key:use}. Put ore into the input slot and take the ingots out.

Steps.Title: Smelt cobalt
Steps.Text: Smelt the cobaltite rock into cobalt ingots.

Steps.Title: The crafting table
Steps.Text: Use the crafting table with {key:use}. It shows everything you can build.

Steps.Title: Energy cells
Steps.Text: Energy cells power machines and tools. Craft two of them.

Steps.Title: A drill bit
Steps.Text: Every drill needs a drill bit. Craft one.

Steps.Title: The Cobalt Drill
Steps.Text: Combine your drill, a drill bit, cobalt ingots and energy cells. The new drill mines iron ore and dense ice.

Steps.Title: Oxygen
Steps.Text: Your oxygen bar drops in space. Melt ice into water in the furnace, craft compressed oxygen and use it with {key:use}.

Steps.Title: Power
Steps.Text: Drilling empties your power. Smelt water into liquid hydrogen, then craft and use a power pack.

Steps.Title: Equipment
Steps.Text: Equipment makes you stronger. Craft a power generator and equip it with {key:use} or in the inventory.
Steps.Hint: Armor adds health and protects against explosions.

Steps.Title: Mark your base
Steps.Text: Press {key:waypoints} to open your waypoints. Add one at your base, then give it a name and a color. Its marker always shows the way back.

Tasks.Label: Add a waypoint at your base

Steps.Title: Mine iron
Steps.Text: With the cobalt drill you can mine iron ore. You will need a lot of it.

Steps.Title: The basic machine
Steps.Text: Most machines are built from a basic machine. Smelt iron and craft one.

Steps.Title: The crusher
Steps.Text: The crusher turns one ore into two dust, and dust smelts into ingots: double the metal! It also makes sand from light rock.

Steps.Title: Storage
Steps.Text: Your inventory is small. Craft a crate and place it in your base.

Steps.Title: Power grid
Steps.Text: A cobalt power block powers machines and lights through cables. Connect a light to it.

Steps.Title: The Iron Drill
Steps.Text: Upgrade your cobalt drill with an iron drill bit, iron ingots and energy cells. It mines thulium ore.

Steps.Title: Thulium
Steps.Text: Mine thulium ore with the iron drill. It does not melt directly: crush it into dust first, then smelt the dust.

Steps.Title: Thulium energy cells
Steps.Text: Thulium lenses (thulium and glass) make strong energy cells.

Steps.Title: The Triple Iron Drill
Steps.Text: Three iron drills, three iron drill bits and six thulium energy cells make the triple iron drill. It is strong enough for titanium and uranium.
Steps.Hint: Open the crafting table to see which ingredients are still missing.

Steps.Title: Titanium and uranium
Steps.Text: Titanium makes the best armor and ship parts, uranium powers reactors and the gravity generator.

Steps.Title: Walls and floors
Steps.Text: Craft aluminium panels and turn them into blocks. Build some walls around your machines.

Steps.Title: Door and window
Steps.Text: A base needs a way in and a view out. Glass comes from sand in the furnace.

Steps.Title: Breathable air
Steps.Text: Close a room completely and place an oxygen generator inside. Give it water and power to fill the room with air.

Steps.Title: A second life
Steps.Text: The DNA reconstructor brings you back at your base when you die.

Steps.Title: How ships work
Steps.Text: Anything you build in open space can fly. Build a small frame away from asteroids, then add thrusters and a console.

Steps.Title: Thrusters
Steps.Text: Each thruster pushes away from its nozzle. Place four of them pointing in different directions.

Steps.Title: Ship console
Steps.Text: The console is the pilot seat. Craft it and place it on the ship.

Steps.Title: Take the seat
Steps.Text: Look at the console and press {key:use} to sit down. Press {key:use} again to leave.

Steps.Title: Bind the thrusters
Steps.Text: While sitting, press {key:inventory} and choose Bind blocks. Click thrusters to give them a key color.

Steps.Title: Fly!
Steps.Text: {key:forward} {key:backward} {key:left} {key:right} move the ship, the mouse steers, {key:sprint} brakes.

Steps.Title: Ship camera
Steps.Text: Place a ship camera and bind it in the console window. Sit down to look through it.

Steps.Title: Cannons
Steps.Text: A weapon console controls cannons. Bind a cannon to it and fire at a rock.

Steps.Title: Gravity
Steps.Text: A gravity generator lets you walk inside your base or ship. Careful: now you can fall!

Steps.Title: Radar
Steps.Text: The radar finds asteroids far away.
